question: At what ritual point should the practitioner commence the Vāstu oblation?
premises: The stream oblation has a defined endpoint.
That endpoint must be reached through performance.
The Vāstu oblation is to be commenced thereafter.
inference: Therefore, the practitioner should begin the Vāstu oblation only after having completed the stream oblation up to its end.
uncertainties: The exact ritual details of dhārāhoma are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Having performed the stream oblation up to its conclusion, one should begin the Vāstu oblation.
